Title: GENKI: A generative framework for scalable and robust metabolic kinetic modeling
Summary: Presents GENKI, a variational autoencoder-based framework for large-scale kinetic modeling of metabolism that recovers kinetically feasible models matching observed phenotypes under genetic and environmental perturbations.

Title: BioEMMA: Automated Generation of Model-Specific Escher-Compatible Maps from KEGG Pathways
Summary: Presents BioEMMA, a tool that automatically generates model-specific Escher-compatible maps from KEGG pathways to support reproducible visualization of genome-scale metabolic models.

Title: A standardized SBML/PRISM benchmark library for stochastic model checking in synthetic biology
Summary: Introduces a standardized SBML/PRISM benchmark library for stochastic model checking of synthetic biological systems modeled as chemical reaction networks.

Title: 13C-Metabolic flux analysis uncovers rewiring in Escherichia coli ΔmetA metabolism and secretion of amino acids in response to methionine limitation
Summary: Uses 13C-metabolic flux analysis to map metabolic rewiring and amino-acid secretion in methionine-auxotrophic Escherichia coli ΔmetA under methionine limitation.

Title: Squidly harnesses enzyme functional hierarchy and contrastive learning to efficiently predict catalytic residues from sequence
Summary: Presents Squidly, a contrastive-learning method that uses enzyme functional hierarchy to predict catalytic residues from sequence, including on low-identity test proteins.

Title: Characterisation of metabolic burden in Pseudomonas putida reveals precursor limitation in heterologous lycopene production
Summary: Characterises metabolic burden layers in Pseudomonas putida during heterologous lycopene production and identifies precursor limitation as a key constraint.

Title: Glucose-driven evolution of Pseudomonas putida unlocks utilization of lignocellulose-derived pentoses for bioproduction
Summary: Uses glucose-driven adaptive evolution of Pseudomonas putida KT2440 to unlock utilization of lignocellulose-derived pentoses for bioproduction.

Title: Metabolic engineering and deep learning-driven protein engineering for N-Acetylneuraminic acid biosynthesis in Escherichia coli
Summary: Combines metabolic engineering and deep learning-driven protein engineering for N-acetylneuraminic acid biosynthesis in Escherichia coli, including knockout of the NeuAc catabolic operon.

Title: Genome-scale overexpression screening identifies product tolerance and efflux transport as key determinants of high-level L-tryptophan production in Escherichia coli
Summary: Uses genome-scale overexpression screening in Escherichia coli to identify product tolerance and efflux transport as key determinants of high-level L-tryptophan production.

Title: Metabolic Engineering Strategies for High-Level α-Pinene Production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
Summary: Presents metabolic engineering strategies for high-level α-pinene production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a renewable monoterpene feedstock.

Title: Biomanufacturing of 2-Pyrone-4,6-dicarboxylic Acid by an Engineered Corynebacterium glutamicum Cell Factory
Summary: Combines metabolic engineering and fermentation process optimization to produce 2-pyrone-4,6-dicarboxylic acid in an engineered Corynebacterium glutamicum cell factory.
